name: autoresearch-tenstorrent
description: A port of karpathy/autoresearch to a single Tenstorrent device: an AI agent edits `train.py`, trains a small GPT for a fixed five-minute budget, keeps or discards the change by validation bits-per-byte, and repeats. The CUDA/H100 assumptions are replaced with a lazy `torch_xla` TT-XLA baseline, with `tt_runtime.py` device glue, bootstrap and Docker scripts for the `tt-xla-slim` image, and TT correctness and training smoke tests. Tested on a Wormhole N300; porting notes and known limitations are documented in `docs/`.
author: bro4all
